sports.note: Hub returned 'No tips found.' at capture time: no snooker event on OLBG currently carries a tipster selection. Snooker markets OLBG documents are Win Match, Handicap Betting, Frame Betting and Win Tournament. No bookable fixture list was exposed, so no snooker lines can be originated from OLBG's own list. Flagged.

The Darts hub currently lists only two events, both tournament-level, with no individual match markets. Match-level darts inventory is therefore limited to what OLBG has opened. Flagged as a data-availability issue, not a pricing gap.
Only one baseball game carried tips at capture time even though the page lists MLB, NPB and KBO coverage. Flagged as a thin board.
OLBG's Gaelic hub is Gaelic Football only. OLBG also runs a Hurling hub (sport id 26) which is outside this brief's listed sports. Only two club fixtures plus one 2027 outright were live.

Race-name clock (e.g. 8:24) and the page's own timestamp (16:24) differ by four hours, consistent with a fixed display offset. Absolute local post time is therefore not confirmed for any race. One race was already labelled Expired at capture. Flagged.

Event page for Wawrinka v Lehecka (event 902232) verified live and lists five markets; this is the authoritative example of OLBG's tennis market ladder. Tip prices are not exposed on event pages, so prices in this project are originated, not copied.
